}}'''Elswell''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]].

==Activities==
She participated in the [[Last Battle]] and survived.

She is one of four Aes Sedai, the others being [[Saerin Asnobar|Saerin]], [[Rubinde Acedone|Rubinde]] and [[Yukiri Haruna|Yukiri]], trying to convince [[Rodel Ituralde]] to take the throne of [[Arad Doman]] after the Last Battle.

== Speculation ==
All the Aes Sedai that persuaded Rodel Ituralde to become King and [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] to become [[Amyrlin]] were [[Sitters]], except Elswell. However, the situation might suggest that Elswell is also a Sitter and, if so, she would be the unknown Sitter of the [[Blue Ajah]]. 

During a Q&A with Brandon Sanderson, he said, with no absolute certainty, that this theory is possibly correct.{{verify}}{{short}}
